MASTER MOTION CALENDAR ON NOV-29-2022 IN 206, DEFENDANT DAGOBAH LABS, INC.'S MOTION TO CONTINUE MARCH 13, 2023 TRIAL DATE WAS HEARD. RORY QUINTANA, ESQ. FOR PLAINTIFF DANIEL KURKA; JOHN SCHAFFER, ESQ. FOR DEFENDANT DAGOBAH LABS, INC. THE COURT DID NOT RECEIVE COURTESY COPIES OF DEFENDANT'S MOVING PAPERS PER LOCAL RULE 2.7(B) AND REQUIRED DEFENDANT'S COUNSEL TO PAY A $60 MOTION FILING FEE VIA E-FILING IN LIEU OF FILING A NEW MOTION. THE COURT FOUND GOOD CAUSE AND GRANTED THE MOTION. THE TRIAL DATE OF 03/13/23 IS CONTINUED TO 07/17/23 IN DEPT. 206 AT 9:30 AM. ALL DISCOVERY TO TRACK THE NEW TRIAL DATE. MOVING PARTY TO PREPARE AND SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER THAT CONFORMS WITH THE COURT'S RULING, APPROVED AS TO FORM. UPON FILING OF THE ORDER, MOVING PARTY TO SERVE ORDER. PARTIES WAIVED NOTICE OF THE NEW TRIAL DATE. JUDGE: SAMUEL K. FENG; MATTER NOT REPORTED (206)
